require(len({item.get("invocation") for item in completions}) == 2,
            "paused switch completions share an invocation")
    baseline = max((item.get("sequence", 0) for item in completions_before),
                   default=0)
    require(all(type(item.get("sequence")) is int
                and item["sequence"] > baseline for item in completions),
            "paused switch completions do not advance past the baseline")
evidence.reason: The fence proof only checks that the record has two distinct invocation IDs and that each claimed sequence is an integer above the pre-pause baseline. It never compares the claimed sequences/order to the final log entry for the same invocation, so a record with reversed completion order or a journal sequence that differs from the log sequence still passes. That defeats the intended full-completion-evidence check; using validate_completed(..., unit=REPAIR_UNIT) or equivalent sequence/order assertions is a routine proof fix, not a new requirement.
